name: vscode-plugins
description: Turborepo workspace for the Git Toolkit and Selection Clipboard VS Code extensions.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:git-toolkit:major: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/git-toolkit version major --tag-version-prefix=git-toolkit-v -m "publish(git-toolkit): release v%s"
scripts.release:git-toolkit:minor: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/git-toolkit version minor --tag-version-prefix=git-toolkit-v -m "publish(git-toolkit): release v%s"
scripts.release:git-toolkit:patch: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/git-toolkit version patch --tag-version-prefix=git-toolkit-v -m "publish(git-toolkit): release v%s"
scripts.release:selection-clipboard:major: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/selection-clipboard version major --tag-version-prefix=selection-clipboard-v -m "publish(selection-clipboard): release v%s"
scripts.release:selection-clipboard:minor: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/selection-clipboard version minor --tag-version-prefix=selection-clipboard-v -m "publish(selection-clipboard): release v%s"
scripts.release:selection-clipboard:patch: pnpm check && pnpm --dir extensions/selection-clipboard version patch --tag-version-prefix=selection-clipboard-v -m "publish(selection-clipboard): release v%s"
